name: Block-internal n-1 / n+1
notes: Floored at the blocks: no filtration mode removes a single-nucleotide deletion, so the DS full-length ceiling is purity_floor() (EQ-PURITY, P-BLOCK-PUR). ~5% fragment-internal carry-through observed (SRC-NATCOMM-2024). See Q-011.

name: Unreacted blocks and partial ligation products
notes: Introduced at ligation ~ (1 - P-LIG-CONV); differ from product by a whole block, so UF/DF clears them, but no oligo-specific clearance number exists - carried as a gap. See Q-036, R-011.

name: Adenylylated dead-end (AppN)
notes: Observed as the [+AMP] by-product in fully modified siRNA blockmer ligation; the fix is to restage the reaction, not to remove it downstream (R-010). ATP requirement vs suppression ceiling tension: Q-040.

name: ATP / AMP / PPi / monovalent salts
notes: The diafiltration workhorse: cleared to a residual of exp(-N) at N = P-DF-DIAVOL diavolumes with sieving ~1 (EQ-DIAF, SRC-PALL-TFF). See Q-020.

name: Divalent cations (Mg2+ / Ca2+)
notes: Bind the polyanion and resist diafiltration; residual is a gap (R-014). The ligation buffer carries MgCl2 (BUF-LIG).

name: Ligase protein
notes: Removed by clarification/centrifugation only if the enzyme is immobilised; no residual-protein clearance (ppm or log) number exists (R-002, Q-032).

name: Splint oligo
cleared_by: designed out (complementary strand is the splint)
notes: For siRNA the complementary product strand acts as the splint, so there is nothing foreign to remove (R-006).

name: Endotoxin (LPS micelles)
notes: Co-retained with product by UF; an adsorber alone left 641 EU/mg against a competing polyanion (R-007). Residual is a gap and the DS limit is dose-derived (Q-037).

name: Aggregates / particulates / bioburden
notes: Cleared by depth and 0.2 um filtration; the bioburden target is <1 CFU/mL at DS (SRC-PMC7415879). See Q-037.
